title: dactylorhiza × maculana
intro: Dactylorhiza × maculana, commonly known as the Spotted Marsh-Orchid, is a hybrid orchid plant that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × maculana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and safety of using Dactylorhiza × maculana as a medicinal plant.
